About.title: An online shop for small, useful things.
About.p1: Wá xɔ means “come and buy” in Fon. We pick everyday items, store them ourselves in Cotonou and deliver them to your door, often the very next day.
About.p2: We have no physical store. When you order, the product leaves straight from our stock: that is what lets us show real stock levels and deliver fast.
About.photo: Team or stock photo to be added
About.c1t: Everything is in stock with us
About.c1p: What you see on the site is available. Stock is updated with every order.
About.c2p: For the home, kitchen, beauty, office, tech and travel, at small prices.
About.c3p: Confirmation on WhatsApp, home delivery, and exchange or refund within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.intro: Can't find your answer? <contact>Write to us</contact>.
Faq.a1: In Cotonou and Calavi, you are delivered the next day for any order placed before {cutoff}:00, Monday to Saturday. In other cities in Benin, allow 48 to 72 hours.
Faq.a2: {cotonou} in Cotonou and Calavi, free from {freeShip} of purchases. {autre} in other cities in Benin.
Faq.a3: By MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Celtiis Cash or bank card (Visa, Mastercard){cod}. We will never ask for your secret code.
Faq.cod: , or on delivery, in cash or by Mobile Money
Faq.q4: Do I need an account to order?
Faq.a4: No. An account lets you track your orders, keep your delivery details and review products. Without an account, you can track your order with its number on the <track>Order tracking</track> page.
Faq.q5: How do I track my order?
Faq.a5: You receive a WhatsApp confirmation with your order number (WX-…). The status is visible in your customer area, or on the <track>Order tracking</track> page using that number.
Faq.a6: Yes, within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of receiving it, for an unused product in its original packaging. Unsealed hygiene products are not taken back, unless faulty. <shipping>See the procedure</shipping>.
Faq.q7: Are the products really in stock?
Faq.a7: Yes. All our products are stored with us in Cotonou and the stock shown is updated with every order.
Faq.a8: Not at the moment. We only deliver within Benin.

s1.p: These terms govern sales made on the Wá xɔ website between <tbc>[company name]</tbc>, <tbc>[legal form]</tbc>, registered in the RCCM under number <tbc>[number]</tbc>, IFU <tbc>[number]</tbc>, whose registered office is at <tbc>[address]</tbc>, Cotonou (“Wá xɔ”), and anyone who places an order (“the customer”). Confirming an order constitutes acceptance of these terms.

s2.p: The products offered are those displayed on the site, while stocks last. Wá xɔ stores its products itself in Cotonou; the stock shown is updated with every order. Photos and descriptions are as accurate as possible; a slight difference in color or packaging is not a non-conformity.

s3.p: Prices are shown in CFA francs, all taxes included. Delivery fees are added to the price of the products and are shown before the order is confirmed. The price charged is the one displayed at the time of the order.

s4.p: The customer selects products, provides delivery details, chooses a payment method and confirms the order. An order number (WX-…) is displayed and a confirmation is sent by WhatsApp or SMS. Wá xɔ may cancel an order in case of incomplete information, a product that has become unavailable or a payment incident; the customer is then fully refunded.

s5.p: Accepted methods: MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Celtiis Cash and Visa or Mastercard bank cards{cod}. Online payments are handled by an approved payment provider; Wá xɔ never has access to secret codes or full card numbers.

s6.p: Cotonou and Calavi: next-day delivery for any order placed before {cutoff}:00, Monday to Saturday, for {cotonou}, free from {freeShip} of purchases. Other cities in Benin: within 48 to 72 hours, for {autre}. The courier calls the customer before arriving. If the customer is absent, a new delivery is offered; after two unsuccessful attempts, the order may be cancelled. No delivery outside Benin for now.

s7.p: The customer has {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} from receipt to request an exchange or a refund, without having to give a reason, for an unused, complete product in its original packaging. Unsealed hygiene or care products (face brush, trimmer, makeup brushes, for example) are neither taken back nor exchanged, unless faulty. The refund is made to the original payment method, or by Mobile Money for a payment on delivery, within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of receiving the returned product. The procedure is on the <shipping>Delivery and returns</shipping> page.

s8.p: Any defect or product error must be reported within 48 hours of receipt, with a photo. Wá xɔ exchanges or refunds the product and covers the return costs.

s9.p: Data collected when ordering is processed in accordance with our <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

s10.p: These terms are governed by Beninese law. In case of a dispute, the customer first contacts customer service to seek an amicable solution. Failing that, the dispute is brought before the competent courts of Cotonou.

s1.p: These terms govern access to the Wá xɔ website and the use of its services: catalog, assistant, customer account and reviews. They supplement the <cgv>terms of sale</cgv>, which apply to every order.

s2.p: The site is free to access. Wá xɔ may suspend access for maintenance or updates.

s3.p: An account is optional for ordering. It is required to track orders and publish a review. The customer provides accurate information and keeps their password confidential. They can edit their details from their area and may ask for their account to be deleted by writing to customer service.

s4.p: Only registered customers can publish a review, one review per product. A review must reflect a real experience with the product. Insulting, discriminatory or defamatory remarks, advertising and third-party personal data are prohibited. Wá xɔ never edits the content of a review; it may hide a review that does not follow these rules. The “Verified purchase” badge indicates that the author received this product through a Wá xɔ order. Reviews are not paid for.

s5.p: The assistant is an automated tool based on artificial intelligence. It helps you choose a product and answers common questions. Its answers may contain errors: the product page, the cart and the terms of sale prevail. Never share a password, Mobile Money code or card number in the conversation.

s6.p: The Wá xɔ name, the logo, the texts and the photos on the site belong to <tbc>[company name]</tbc> or to their authors. Any reproduction without permission is prohibited.

s7.p: Wá xɔ strives for the accuracy of the information published but cannot guarantee the total absence of errors. It is not liable for damage caused by misuse of the site or an interruption of the service.

s8.p: These terms may change. The applicable version is the one published on this page.

s2.p: For an order: name, phone, delivery address, products ordered and chosen payment method. For an account: first name, last name, phone, email, password (stored in encrypted form), order history and published reviews. For the newsletter: email or WhatsApp number. For contact and the assistant: the content of your messages. Online payments are handled directly by our payment provider; Wá xɔ keeps neither secret codes nor full card numbers.

s3.p: Preparing, delivering and tracking your orders; contacting you about an order; managing your account and reviews; sending you the newsletter if you asked for it; replying to your messages; improving the site.

s4.p: The Wá xɔ team, the courier (name, phone and address only), the payment provider, the site host and the provider of the artificial intelligence technology behind the assistant, to generate answers. Your data is never sold.

s5.p: Account: until deleted, or 3 years after your last activity. Orders and invoices: for the period required by accounting regulations. Newsletter: until you unsubscribe. Messages: 1 year.

s6.p: You can access your data, correct it, object to its use or ask for its deletion by writing to {email}. You can also contact the Personal Data Protection Authority (APDP, apdp.bj).

s7.p: The site stores on your device your cart, the products you viewed (for the personalized selection) and your sign-in session. <tbc>[State here the audience measurement tool, if any.]</tbc>

s8.p: Exchanges with the site are encrypted (HTTPS) and access to data is restricted to authorized people.
